nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: Calloway. You look like a man about to report a crime. Don't.

choices.text: Just admiring the law at work.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: Forgery's a big accusation. Big words mean forms. Forms mean ink. You see my difficulty.

nodes.speaker: Cole
nodes.text: Clear as the badge you're not wearing.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: Mm. The law rests so it can be fresh. That's in a book somewhere.
